stage_note: Challenge (implementation run): (1) design CHALLENGE 1 said the UA should identify CIP; D-0063 supersedes it with an ordinary desktop browser UA, no evasion. (2) Design says Amazon stays off until decision 1; the current poller polls Amazon actives and U1 does not change which marketplaces are polled (open item for Warren). (3) No site-state table exists (U2 M2), so the per-site pause lives in Redis with TTL, process-local fallback; not durable across a Redis flush. (4) consecutive_failures column is U2 M4; U1 keeps the count in customer_listing.meta_json. (5) A 10-minute run on the solo worker blocks other tasks for up to 10 min every 30 min (accepted in design CHALLENGE 7).
